_meta.description: Phase 2 calibration anchors for STANDARD comp ratio, comp release, gate release, gate range, limiter threshold
_meta.method: Guided probe: user set parameter to specific positions in UC Surface, probe CLI captured state; comp.release and gate.range are scene-stored (not live-updated via featherbear)

comp_ratio_standard.formula: 1 + 0.922 * (raw/(1-raw))^0.781  [0 < raw < 1]; 1.0 at raw=0; Infinity at raw=1 (Limit mode)

eq_band_types_standard.description: EQ filter type (line.chN.eq.bandN.eqtype) for STANDARD EQ model
eq_band_types_standard.note: STANDARD EQ has NO LOW_PASS type. Only 3 types used: BELL (all bands), LOW_SHELF (band-1 only), HIGH_SHELF (band-4 only). raw=0.0 does NOT occur in STANDARD EQ.
